Sentiment is +0.35 (positive), and the stock is up modestly (+0.4%) on heavy news flow. DIS has been consolidating near its 30-day range midpoint. The combination of earnings beat, sold-out Super Bowl ad inventory, and positive streaming momentum (Toy Story 5 boost) provides a multi-pronged thesis. We have no prior position and no anti-reversal constraint. Sizing at 5% is appropriate for an initial position in a name with solid but not exceptional near-term edge.

Trump's 'making too much money' rhetoric adds political/regulatory overhang. While Freedom Broker upgraded XOM today, the macro tailwinds that justified our original position (Hormuz supply risk) are fading. The position is already small at 4.9% after prior trims, but given continued headwinds, full exit is appropriate to free capital for better opportunities.

The Iran-Oman Hormuz coordinates agreement and US lifting sanctions on Fly Baghdad (previously IRGC-linked) are new, concrete developments since our morning buy that signal accelerating normalization. EOG is down 4.1% from entry, approaching the threshold where the risk/reward deteriorates further. The position has been partially trimmed already. Full exit frees cash and eliminates the energy sector concentration risk.

recent_trades.summary: Fully exiting CVX as Trump's public attacks on Chevron for 'making too much money' add new political/regulatory risk on top of the already-weakened de-escalation thesis.

The position is only 1.95% of portfolio and -2.65% from my entry of $192.58. Exiting cleans up the book and frees a small amount of capital. Sentiment is -0.23 today. The combination of Iran de-escalation (removing supply disruption premium) + Trump political targeting of CVX specifically creates enough pressure to justify a full exit.
